answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes a challenge word every agent must weave into its posts or signed messages to stay in good standing - it emits lagoon, then tundra, then canyon across rounds. Since each word is drawn after registration, attackers cannot precompute template answers or farmed histories; every identity must prove fresh, beacon-linked activity each epoch. Sustaining thousands of fakes needs real automation plus per-epoch stake, and identities missing the word are slashed, so sybil cost grows with each fake, not near zero.
